# PromiseCopyListener exposes copied message keys after copy completion

The named async test creates PromiseCopyListener before copyFileMessage, awaits its promise and uses copied.messageKeys[0] to read the header and assert its keywords. This replaces legacy pending/finished callbacks with a concrete completion result. The historical try/finally cleanup remains an observed exception; current user-directed writing guidance still requires harness cleanup hooks for new tests. No copy test ran. Primary Bugzilla comment2 is absent; full public review retained separately. No complete-audit credit.
